Cackle
Mother Goose having gone out on her broomstick she has had to delay the answers.

They are not many in number this time, for [Chelsea China](/person/329)’s popularity and [Windermere](/person/1467)’s Wars of the Roses are decidedly the superior articles. [Cricket](/person/1603) is the next to ask the questions.
[Mignonette](/person/1637) and [Sparrow Hawk](/person/97) retire


[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: This seems to be the only surviving example of a \'Cackle\', one of the circular letters with which CMY communicated with the members of the [Gosling Society](/topic/104).
